|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E4 of [[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]; it is the current text. Other versions: [[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (Original), [[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), [[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1220-36-front-master.png]]; a text-only slip like the release sheet's, with errata mark E and no slip number).
* '''Original''' ([[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 3, slip 36. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Floating Refinery, a non-unique cloud sector, or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control two cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” The wiki writes the deploy icon (▼) and the Immune to Alter icon out (“deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, “(Immune to Alter.)”).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1220_36-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended on opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Floating Refinery, a non-unique cloud sector, or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control two cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “suspended during opponent's turn” became “suspended on opponent's turn”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 25 February 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual2-Dark">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/</code>, every card image dated 25 February 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034549/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Floating Refinery, a non-unique cloud sector, or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control two cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' “suspended on opponent's turn” became “suspended during opponent's turn” again: word for word the original text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]]): Competitive Balance Team errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 9 October 2013, effective immediately (to keep cloud decks to the Bespin system; “Note that it also now pulls unique cloud sectors to Bespin as well”)<ref name="forum-p841760">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by darkjediknight11, 9 October 2013: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p841760 p841760] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy a Floating Refinery, a cloud sector (to Bespin), or an Obsidian squadron TIE on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control 2 cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “suspended during” is back; “deploy one Floating Refinery, a non-unique cloud sector” became “deploy a Floating Refinery, a cloud sector (to Bespin)”; the post writes “TIE on table from Reserve Deck” and “if you control 2 cloud sectors” (the PC website also posted this erratum on 9 October 2013).
* '''PC-E4''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (cover “official text as of 27 April 2013”, but it already has the October 2013 errata; PDF built 3 February 2014; Dark Side, p. 26)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=26, page 26. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=26 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy a Floating Refinery, a cloud sector (to Bespin), or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control two cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “TIE on table” became “TIE” and “2 cloud sectors” became “two cloud sectors” (the slip prints ▼ for the deploy).
